content.introduction: Broadcom stock is a buy due to its strong track record, accelerating sales, and robust AI demand, with analysts raising price targets ahead of its Q2 earnings report.
body: Broadcom declined alongside a broader semiconductor sector pullback, with investors rotating cautiously ahead of Nvidia's highly anticipated earnings Wednesday and as surging bond yields — the 30-year Treasury hitting a near-20-year high above 5.19% — pressured high-multiple tech stocks. Broadcom surged to near its 52-week high, driven by a major analyst upgrade from Wells Fargo, which raised its price target to $545 from $430 — one of the most dramatic large-cap semiconductor revisions of the year — arguing that AI semiconductor revenue is tracking 30–40% above prior Wall Street expectations. Despite the macro headwinds, Citi raised its price target on Broadcom to $500 (from $475), reiterating a Buy rating ahead of the June 3 fiscal Q2 earnings report, citing AI demand strength and Broadcom's $73B AI backlog anchored by long-term deals with Meta, Google, and Anthropic.
